signals.description: Surface scratches across the screen glass (EV-2) suggest rough handling, although the description reports no damage at all.

evidenceRefs.observation: Legible invoice from Aurora Store for an Aurora Tab 10 (AUR-TAB10), serial AT10-24-0015, 450.00 USD, dated on the stated purchase date.
Front photo: black, unlit screen with fine surface scratches across the glass; no cracks.
Back photo: serial label shows AT10-24-0015, matching the claim.

structuredOutput.reasoningSummary: The tablet stopped powering on during normal use, which is a manufacturing defect covered by POL-8. The invoice (EV-1) matches the claimed seller, model, serial, price and purchase date, and the purchase in North America is within the 12-month warranty period of POL-1. The front photo (EV-2) shows surface scratches on the screen glass that the description does not mention; they are cosmetic and unrelated to the power failure, and no exclusion applies. Recommend approval and repair at an authorized service center.
structuredOutput.claimantExplanation: Your Aurora Tab 10 is covered by the Aurora Limited Warranty. It stopped powering on during normal use, which is a manufacturing defect, and it was purchased within the 12-month warranty period that applies in North America. We are arranging a repair at an authorized service center and will contact you with the details.
